map.累计折现现金流回正年限 使用指南: Years Until Cumulative Discounted Cash Flow Turns Positive User Guide
map.折现回收期计算器。输入各期现金流与折现率，求累计折现现金流由负转正的年限，考虑时: Discounted payback period calculator. Enter cash flows and the discount rate to find the year the cumulative discounted cash flow turns from negative to positive — a payback assessment that accounts for the time value of money, used for project investment evaluation.
map.折现回收期 = 累计折现现金流回正年限: Discounted payback period = years until cumulative discounted cash flow turns positive
map.考虑时间价值的回收期。: Payback that accounts for the time value of money.
map.考虑资金时间价值，看投资多久回本。: Account for the time value of money to see how long an investment takes to pay back.
map.和静态回收期比，更保守。: More conservative than the static payback period.
map.考虑资金成本后，判断真正回本需要多长时间。: After accounting for the cost of capital, judge how long it really takes to break even.

map.为什么不只用静态回收期？: Why not use only the static payback period?
map.静态忽略折现，早期现金更值钱；折现回收期更真实但仍有忽略回收期后现金流的缺点。: Static payback ignores discounting and values early cash higher; discounted payback is more realistic but still ignores cash flows after payback.
map.和普通回收期差多少？: How much does it differ from the ordinary payback period?
map.同样现金流不折现时累计为 −5000、−2500、0、+2500，恰好 2 年回: The same cash flows undiscounted accumulate to −5000, −2500, 0, +2500, paying back in exactly 2 years; discounted it is about 2.35 years. The extra 0.35 years is the cost of capital tied up, and the gap widens as the discount rate rises.
